findings.description: The commit moves headers back to Mapping, but HeadersType was changed to Mapping[str, object], where the old alias used str | bytes values. Header values of any type now type-check.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes headers={'X-Count': 5} or a None value. Previously the type checker rejected this. Now it passes, and at runtime check_header_validity raises InvalidHeader for non-str/bytes values. Users lose static checking for a real runtime error. Restoring Mapping[str, str | bytes] would match the title.
